steps.action_code:
def _normalize_account_name(value):
    return "".join(character for character in str(value).lower() if character.isalnum())

def _account_password(app_name):
    target = _normalize_account_name(app_name)
    exact = [record for record in account_password_records if _normalize_account_name(record["account_name"]) == target]
    candidates = exact or [record for record in account_password_records if target in _normalize_account_name(record["account_name"]) or _normalize_account_name(record["account_name"]) in target]
    assert candidates
    return candidates[0]["password"]

simple_note_password = _account_password("simple_note")
simple_note_login = apis.simple_note.login(username=supervisor_profile["email"], password=simple_note_password)
simple_note_access_token = simple_note_login["access_token"]
verification_targets: A Simple Note access token is stored without printing the password or token.
